Vendored from the npm package `blockly@9.3.3`, which ships no LICENSE file of
its own; its package.json declares "license": "Apache-2.0". Only the files this
app loads are kept: blockly_compressed.js, blocks_compressed.js,
python_compressed.js, msg/en.js and media/ (the toolbox icons and sounds
Blockly fetches at runtime from its media path).

The `//# sourceMappingURL=` comment is stripped from each file: the .map files
are megabytes, are of no use in production, and — because production uses
ManifestStaticFilesStorage — a reference to a map that is not collected makes
`collectstatic` raise and the deploy fail outright.
